passages.original: sic cecinit pro te doctus, Minoi, Catullus
passages.english: So learned Catullus sang on your behalf, daughter of Minos,
passages.notes: "Minoi" is the vocative of Minois, "daughter of Minos", i.e. Ariadne; the reference is to Catullus' lament of Ariadne. The line is incomplete in sense and continues in the following verse.
